evals.prompt: List all Cloud Run services and Pub/Sub topics in GCP project acme-prod-123
expectations: Uses list_services action with project_id acme-prod-123
Uses list_topics action with project_id acme-prod-123
Returns structured JSON with service and topic lists

evals.prompt: List Cloud Run services without specifying a project_id
expectations: Returns a validation error, does NOT attempt the API call
Error includes a descriptive message about missing project_id
Status field is 'error' with error_code indicating validation failure

evals.prompt: Delete a Cloud Run service named auth-api in project acme-prod-123
expectations: Response clearly states the agent is read-only
